static_traits.name: Chen Keyi
static_traits.medical_history: Not yet received psychotherapy, no major physical illness history

basic_info.main_problem: I failed a literature exam in my freshman year, feeling overwhelmed by the thought of possibly having to drop out.
basic_info.core_demands: The fear of failure and dropping out makes it hard for me to bear alone, so I seek counseling.

core_beliefs: I am not smart enough / do not belong here

special_situations.event: Receiving the failing grade on the literature exam
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If failing one exam, it means I am not suited for college, I am not smart enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubling study efforts to prove oneself, while reducing socializing to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I may have to drop out

special_situations.event: Facing academic challenges or receiving performance feedback from teachers/courses
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot keep performing excellently, it equals total failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessive worrying and self-monitoring, avoiding socializing
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: One failure means I will fail every time in the future

special_situations.event: A transition period where stress and demands rise markedly after entering university
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot adapt well to the college pace immediately, it means I am not good enough and do not belong here
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forces herself to study harder, trying to reach perfection
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not smart enough, possibly unable to handle harder courses

special_situations.event: Starts panicking while working on an assignment
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not do well on this assignment, it proves my overall academic ability is insufficient
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Falling into excessive worry; reducing interactions with friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will fail again; things will only get worse

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as capable and good enough, to stay securely at university and complete my studies
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure leading to being negated, being seen as not good enough, thus losing the future and sense of worth
defense_goal: Avoiding being negated by maintaining high standards and pursuing perfection
Reducing socializing to lower the risk of being judged by others

object_relations.self_representation: A Student not smart enough, possibly failing at any time
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh judges (university environment / others / evaluation system)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about or facing discussion and evidence examination of 'whether failure can determine overall ability'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to keep distance from emotions through rational analysis and abstraction, avoiding being overwhelmed by unbearable experiences
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle tone, empathizing and validating feelings, using open-ended questions to guide concretizing experiences, encouraging acknowledging both rational and emotional sides, avoiding arguing and judging.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing others' feedback or possible evaluation (exam scores, homework grading, peer discussions)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Seeing others and the environment as 'all-good or all-bad' judges, believing once not good enough one will be completely negated
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using gentle inquiry and reflection, inviting identifying grays and complexity, encouraging examples supporting multi-dimensional evaluation, avoiding reinforcing binary language.

manifestations: Seeing one failure as evidence of 'having no future'
Avoids interacting with friends out of fear of failure and dropping out
Thinks others can hardly understand one's plight
outcomes: Social withdrawal and increased sense of isolation

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeatedly berating oneself in conversation with 'I am not smart enough / do not belong'
Overly focuses on whether one's own performance meets standards, worries about being judged by others

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Reducing contact with friends, repressing fear and stress inward and bearing them alone
Under stress, seeks help less and instead self-blames and consumes oneself internally

positive_force: Having some rational reflection ability (able to distinguish rational from emotional)
Willing to seek professional help and try new strategies (keeping a journal, restructuring thoughts)
Has some social support (friends to confide in)
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking prominent
Over-predicts the worst outcomes (jumping to conclusions)
Social avoidance leading to decreased support and negative cycles
Anxiety causing sleep and diet disturbance, further impairing functioning

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophizing and strong anxiety related to academics
antecedent: Facing academic challenges or homework/exam feedback
Thinking about the college transition and harder courses
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralization of failure and black-and-white evaluation, worrying about being negated and losing the future (college transition increasing stress)
target_behavior.function: Avoids the threat of being evaluated and failing, gaining a temporary sense of control and safety
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent anxiety and sense of hopelessness, sleep and eating disrupted, academic performance affected

antecedent: Anticipating others will evaluate one's failure
When worry about failing again intensifies
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing exposing the 'incompetent / not good enough' self-image, avoiding being negated by others
target_behavior.function: Avoiding external evaluation and emotional triggers, lowering immediate anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Rising sense of isolation, weakened support system, anxiety and despair further intensifying
